message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is an extreme technical breakdown for exact replication:

### 1. Exact Color Palette (Hex Codes)
*   **Primary Background (Main Area):** `#1a3b5c` (Deep Slate Blue) with a subtle vertical gradient to `#15304a` at the bottom.
*   **Sidebar Background:** `#ffffff` (Pure White).
*   **Top Bar Background:** `#1e2d4a` (Dark Navy).
*   **Accent/Primary Action:** `#c9862e` (Mustard Gold) used for the "Start Lesson" button and active progress bars.
*   **Secondary Accent (Outline):** `#d4923a` (Lighter Gold) used for the "Open Quiz Center" button border.
*   **Card/Tag Backgrounds:** `#2a4a6a` (Semi-transparent dark blue, ~15% opacity over main bg).
*   **Text Primary (White):** `#ffffff`.
*   **Text Secondary (Muted):** `#8ba3bc` (Steel Blue-Grey).
*   **Text Dark (Sidebar):** `#333333` (Headings), `#666666` (Subtext).
*   **Success Green:** `#27ae60` (Checkmarks).
*   **Alert Red:** `#e74c3c` (Notification badge).

### 2. Layout Structure
*   **Overall Layout:** Two-column layout with a fixed left sidebar (~260px width) and a fluid right main content area.
*   **Sidebar Position:** Fixed left, full height, with a subtle right border (`#e0e0e0`, 1px). Contains a scrollable list of chapters.
*   **Main Content:** Fills remaining width, has internal padding of ~40px horizontal and ~30px vertical. Features rounded corners on the outer container (`border-radius: 16px`) creating a "window" effect against a darker backdrop.

### 3. Top Bar Elements & Positions
Located at the very top of the viewport (full width):
*   **Left:** Breadcrumb/Title: **"⚠️ GAT 2026 · Chapter 2: Geometry"** in bold white text (~16px).
*   **Sub-header (Below Top Bar):** "Mrs. Shaimaa Darwish · Interactive Workbook" in smaller muted text (~12px, color `#8ba3bc`).
*   **Center-Right Toolbar (Inside Main Content):**
    *   Print icon
    *   Warning triangle icon
    *   Rocket icon
    *   **Timer:** "LESSON 25 : 00" (Monospace font)
    *   **Question Timer:** "Q 0 : 00"
    *   Play/Pause button (Circle icon)
    *   Undo/Reset icon
    *   **Score Display:** "Score: 19 / 19" (White text)
    *   **"Show Answers" Button:** Text button with icon.
    *   **Icon Cluster:** A series of circular tool icons (looks like Chrome extension or app shortcuts) spaced evenly.
    *   **"Cover" Button:** Text link on far right.

### 4. Main Content Area Structure
*   **Header Badge:** Pill-shaped tag: `background: #c9862e`, text "GAT 2026 · CHAPTER 2 · GEOMETRY", uppercase, bold, small font (~11px), padding `8px 20px`, `border-radius: 20px`.
*   **Hero Title:** Large text "GAT 2026 · Chapter 2: Geometry" (~36px, Bold, Color `#f0c060` - Golden Yellow). Preceded by a large warning triangle icon (same gold color).
*   **Subtitle:** "Mrs. Shaimaa Darwish · Professional Interactive Workbook" (~18px, Regular weight, Color `#8ba3bc`).
*   **Feature Grid:** Two rows of pill-shaped feature tags:
    *   *Row 1:* 7 Lessons, 90 Questions, MCQ & Comparison, Answer Keys, Per-Lesson Timer, Per-Question Stopwatch.
    *   *Row 2:* Strategy Boxes, 74 Figures.
    *   *Style:* Background `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`, Border `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)`, `border-radius: 12px`, Padding `10px 16px`, Font size ~14px, Icon + Text format.
*   **Action Buttons (CTA):**
    *   **Primary:** "Start Lesson 2.1 →" - Solid Gold background (`#c9862e`), White text, Bold, `padding: 14px 32px`, `border-radius: 12px`.
    *   **Secondary:** "🚀 Open Quiz Center" - Transparent background, Gold border (`2px solid #d4923a`), Gold text, same sizing as primary.
    *   *Layout:* Placed side-by-side with ~12px gap.

### 5. Card Styles
*   **Container Card:** The entire right side is treated as a card with `box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)` and `border-radius: 16px`.
*   **Sidebar Items:** No visible cards, but list items have hover states (light grey highlight `#f5f5f5`).
*   **Bottom Section ("Question of the Day"):** Appears to be a separate panel with a darker gradient overlay at the bottom of the main area.

### 6. Typography Hierarchy
*   **Font Family:** System UI / Inter / Segoe UI (Clean sans-serif).
*   **H1 (Chapter Title):** 32-36px, Weight 800 (ExtraBold), Color Gold (`#eec658`).
*   **H2 (Section/Lesson):** 16px, Weight 700 (Bold), Color Dark (`#222`).
*   **Body (Descriptions):** 14px, Weight 400, Color Muted Grey (`#666` or `#8ba3bc` depending on context).
*   **Meta Data (Questions counts):** 12px, Weight 500, Color Light Grey (`#888`).
*   **Badges/Tags:** 11-12px, Weight 600, Uppercase tracking-wide.

### 7. Button Styles
*   **Primary Buttons:** 
    *   Background: Linear gradient or solid `#d4923a` to `#b87a22`.
    *   Shadow: `0 4px 12px rgba(201, 134, 46, 0.3)`.
    *   Hover: Slight lift effect (`transform: translateY(-2px)`).
*   **Icon Buttons (Top bar):** Circular, `40x40px`, Background `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`, Border-radius `50%`, Hover `rgba(255,255,255,0.2)`.
*   **Ghost/Text Buttons:** No background, underline on hover, color matches accent or white.

### 8. Decorative Elements
*   **Background Pattern:** The main blue area has extremely faint geometric line patterns (triangles/grid) at ~5% opacity.
*   **Gradient Overlay:** Bottom of main content fades to a darker shade (`#0f2537`) suggesting scrollable content below.
*   **Icons:** Uses a consistent icon set (likely Phosphor Icons or Heroicons) with stroke width 2px.
*   **Warning Triangle:** Used as a brand motif (gold filled triangle with exclamation mark).

### 9. Question/Quiz Card Design (Visible at Bottom)
*   **Header:** Star icon + "QUESTION OF THE DAY" + Yellow "NEW" badge (bg `#f1c40f`, text `#000`, tiny font, bold).
*   **Content Area:** Starts with "If the angles of a triangle are in the ratio..." (truncated).
*   **Style:** Darker background than main area (`#163048`), distinct separation from upper content.

### 10. Sidebar Specifics (Left Panel)
*   **Header:** "CHAPTER LESSONS" in uppercase, letter-spacing 1px, 12px, grey, with a red notification bubble "19" (circle, red bg, white text, absolute position top-right of header).
*   **Icon Row:** Moon mode toggle, Notification bell (with red dot), Edit/Pen icon, Chart icon.
*   **List Items:**
    *   **Active (2.1):** Has green checkmark, title "Lines & Angles", subtext "Questions 1 – 16 · 16 Q · 100%", thick green bottom border (`3px solid #27ae60`).
    *   **Inactive (2.2, 2.4):** Standard text, no checkmark, light grey bottom divider (`1px solid #eee`).
    *   **Current/Dot (2.3, 2.5):** Small green dot indicator (`8px circle, #27ae60`) next to number.
*   **Spacing:** Each item has `padding: 16px 20px`.

### Implementation Notes for Replication:
Use CSS Grid for the main layout: `grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr`. Use Flexbox for the top toolbar alignment (`justify-content: space-between`). Ensure the main container has `overflow-y: auto` and `max-height: 90vh` to create the scrolling window effect seen in the screenshot. The color scheme relies heavily on **blue-gold contrast** (complementary colors) for visual hierarchy.
